items.headline: RBI MPC Meeting Underway; Repo Rate Expected to Remain Unchanged
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India's Monetary Policy Committee is holding its three-day meeting, with economists largely expecting the benchmark repo rate to be held at 5.25% despite a recent rise in retail inflation.

items.headline: India's Retail Inflation Rises to 4.38% in June, Wholesale Inflation at 9.87%
items.summary: India's CPI inflation accelerated to 4.38% in June 2026, crossing the RBI's 4% target for the first time in 17 months but remaining within the tolerance band. WPI inflation reached 9.87% year-on-year in June 2026.

items.headline: Government to Simplify Tax Exemptions for Offshore Investment Funds
items.summary: The Finance Minister is expected to introduce a bill to simplify tax exemptions for offshore investment funds managed from India and provide tax exemptions for foreign companies in customs bonded areas, aiming to strengthen India as a global fund management hub.

items.headline: Global Geopolitical Tensions Push Crude Oil Prices Higher, Posing Inflation Risks for India
items.summary: Heightened geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and disruptions around the Strait of Hormuz are driving crude oil prices higher, which poses inflation risks for oil-importing economies like India.

items.headline: US Fed Hawkish Stance and Rising Oil Prices Impact Rupee and Foreign Fund Inflows
items.summary: The US Federal Reserve's hawkish stance and elevated US Treasury yields are being monitored for their potential to moderate foreign portfolio inflows into Indian debt. A weakening rupee against the dollar, partly due to rising oil prices, also adds to import costs.

items.headline: Q1 FY27 Earnings Season Nears End; Focus on Mid & Small-Caps
items.summary: The first half of August marks the final leg of the Q1 FY27 earnings season, with investors closely watching results from mid-cap and small-cap companies and management commentary on demand trends and margins.

items.headline: Adani Enterprises, L&T Q1 FY27 Earnings Below Expectations
items.summary: Adani Enterprises Ltd reported earnings below expectations at -7.41 INR, and Larsen & Toubro's earnings of 29.96 INR were also below expectations. Conversely, Adani Ports earnings were above expectations at 15.71 INR.

items.headline: Rate-Sensitive Sectors Brace for RBI Policy Impact Amid Expected Pause
items.summary: While the RBI is expected to maintain its policy stance, any change could impact rate-sensitive sectors like banking, real estate, and automobiles. Ample liquidity in the banking system is anticipated to support government bond yields.

items.headline: Hot Stocks on Business Portals: Suzlon, Adani Group, IRFC, Tata Motors PV, BHEL, Dr Reddy, Vodafone Idea
items.summary: A business news portal highlighted several companies, including Suzlon Energy, Adani Enterprises, Adani Power, IRFC, Tata Motors PV, BHEL, Dr Reddy, and Vodafone Idea, as 'hot stocks' for investor attention.
